source_name: Banka Slovenije – Katalog informacij javnega značaja (public information catalogue)
why_relevant: Statutorily required catalogue that enumerates the laws governing BS AND the sklepi and other regulations adopted by the Svet Banke Slovenije, plus the routes for freedom-of-information requests. Acts as an authoritative index/pointer to the full corpus of BS general acts, and documents the legal channel for requesting non-published material.

source_name: Banka Slovenije – Kazalo vsebine (full site index / sitemap)
why_relevant: Human-curated full sitemap of bsi.si. The cheapest reliable way to enumerate every relevant BS page (including low-traffic ones such as the fintech contact point, technical guidelines, and supervisory disclosure pages) and to detect newly created sections over time.

source_name: Banka Slovenije – Arhiv navodil (archive of superseded instructions)
why_relevant: Historical archive of withdrawn/superseded BS instructions. Valuable for reconstructing the timeline of a rule (when a navodilo was replaced, and by what) — i.e. retrospective deadline and transition-period reconstruction.

source_name: Ministrstvo za gospodarstvo, turizem in šport – consumer protection sector / IRPS provider list
why_relevant: The ministry maintaining the IRPS register and drafting consumer legislation (ZVPot-1, ZPotK-2). Legacy list URL was on mgrt.gov.si; content has migrated to gov.si, so the exact deep link must be re-discovered rather than assumed.

source_name: ZBS – Organiziranost (committee / working-group structure)
why_relevant: Maps the ZBS committee architecture (Odbor za plačilni promet, Odbor za kartično poslovanje, Odbor za skladnost poslovanja, Odbor za preprečevanje pranja denarja, Odbor za pravna vprašanja, Odbor za informacijsko varnost, Odbor za informatiko). Each committee is a pointer to named bank experts, workstreams and the regulatory files the sector is actually working on.

source_name: ZBS – Članice (member list of Slovenian banks and savings banks)
why_relevant: Canonical, association-maintained roster of Slovenian banks, savings banks and branches of foreign banks — the firm-level pointer set for the whole SI banking cell, and a cross-check against the Banka Slovenije register.

source_name: EBA — Interactive Single Rulebook / Regulation and policy hub
why_relevant: Canonical index mapping Level 1 EU acts to the RTS/ITS/Guidelines under them, with application dates. Best single pointer for enumerating what will bind Slovenian institutions and when.

source_name: EBA – Registers and other lists of institutions (hub)
why_relevant: Parent hub listing all EBA registers (credit institutions, PSD2 payment/EMI, crowdfunding, credit servicers, etc.). Snowballing this page yields further EU-level populations that include SI entities.

source_name: ATVP – Nadzorniki na finančnem trgu (supervisor cross-reference page)
why_relevant: Official map of Slovenian financial-market supervisors (ATVP, AZN, Banka Slovenije) with links — a compact actor-map seed for expanding the adjacent-supervisor cell.

source_name: AZN – Katalog informacij javnega značaja
why_relevant: Statutory catalogue listing every category of information the agency holds and publishes — a systematic map for finding non-obvious datasets and FOI (ZDIJZ) request targets.

source_name: Gospodarska zbornica Slovenije (GZS) – Sekcije / branch associations index
why_relevant: Master index of GZS branch chambers and sections; the route to the finance-adjacent and digital bodies (accounting services chamber, insurance brokers association, IT & telecoms association, cybersecurity section). GZS is a standard consultee on business-affecting draft legislation.

source_name: ZPS – 'Kam se obrniti, ko so kratene pravice potrošnikom' (map of supervisory bodies)
why_relevant: Consumer-NGO-authored directory of Slovenian supervisory and complaint-handling institutions — an efficient actor-map seed for snowballing further ADR/complaint bodies beyond banking.

source_name: EPC — Register of Participants / scheme participant lists (Slovenian PSPs)
why_relevant: Shows which Slovenian PSPs have adhered to each EPC scheme, i.e. who is contractually bound and who is still to onboard — a concrete adoption-gap indicator for SI.

source_name: Bizi.si – SI company registry data on fintech/EMI entities
why_relevant: Commercial mirror of AJPES company data; resolves legal names, ownership and status of small SI EMIs/CASPs (e.g. DINARO d.o.o.) that only appear as bare names in regulator registers.

source_name: Nexi Slovenija d.o.o. (ex-NETS CEE, ex-Intesa Sanpaolo Card) — card processing operator
why_relevant: The second processing pole in SI alongside Bankart, and an NSP member. Registry/business-intelligence entries (Bizi, eBonitete, CompanyWall — the Dun & Bradstreet/ex-Bisnode-style layer) are the practical way to track corporate identity changes, ownership and legal-entity continuity of SI processing operators, which repeatedly rename.

source_name: European e-Justice Portal – National legislation: Slovenia
why_relevant: EU-maintained English-language description of the Slovenian legal-information architecture (PIS, its ~15 integrated databases, Uradni list as gazette of record, language coverage). Best onboarding map of which Slovenian database holds what, and a stable pointer when national portals are restructured.

source_name: e-Justice / gov.si — 'Na katerih spletiščih se objavijo uradna obvestila?' (SI official publication map)
why_relevant: Authoritative EU/national map of which Slovenian websites carry which mandatory official announcements, including procurement. Useful to guarantee the source inventory for this cell has no legally-required publication channel missing (Uradni list RS, portal javnih naročil, AJPES, etc.).

source_name: Ketler & Partners (member of Karanovic) — banking, payment services and fintech regulatory practice
why_relevant: Explicitly ranked for financial-services regulatory and advisory work covering banking, payment services, fintech products, factoring, leasing and FX — the narrowest fit to this run's payments scope among SI firms. Chambers profile is the confirmed pointer; the firm's own alert channel still needs locating.

source_name: N-Lex - Slovenian national law collection (EU access point)
why_relevant: The European Commission's documented gateway into each member state's national legal database, including a description page for the Slovenian collection. Valuable as an independent, English-language description of which Slovenian database is authoritative and how it is queried - exactly the kind of pointer that stays correct across the 2026 Uradni list to PISRS migration.

source_name: Sistem Activa — multilateral card clearing system (Wikipedia SL entry as pointer)
why_relevant: Documents a second SI clearing rail: the Activa multilateral clearing system for card claims, operated by Banka Intesa Sanpaolo with daily settlement across TARGET2/T2 Slovenia accounts. Useful as an entry point to an actor easily missed when only Bankart is tracked; must be corroborated against Banka Slovenije's operator register.

source_name: Akademija Finance - regulatory training events (ZInfV-1 in DORA)
why_relevant: Event agendas list the consultants, law firms, vendors and bank compliance officers actually working DORA/ZInfV-1 in Slovenia, with dates. Speaker lists are one of the cheapest ways to snowball the SI regtech supplier map and to date deadline pressure.

source_name: Digitalna koalicija Slovenije – Delovne skupine (working groups)
why_relevant: National multi-stakeholder digital coalition whose working groups (incl. a blockchain working group uniting Blockchain Think Tank Slovenije, Blockchain Alliance Europe and Bitcoin društvo Slovenije) coordinate industry input into digital/crypto legislation. Strong pointer into the SI fintech self-organisation layer.

source_name: European Banking Federation – Slovenia country page (ZBS as national member)
why_relevant: Confirms ZBS's EBF membership and gives a stable English-language profile plus contact/leadership pointers; EBF positions are the umbrella under which ZBS often aligns, so EBF position papers are a proxy for the SI association line.

source_name: European Commission – Alternative dispute resolution for consumers (SI page) / e-justice national bodies list
why_relevant: EU-level pointer into national ADR frameworks and the non-judicial bodies list for Slovenia; useful to detect EU-driven changes (ADR Directive revision, ODR platform decommissioning) that will force Slovenian channel redesign.

source_name: European Commission FIN-NET – members in Slovenia
why_relevant: Authoritative EU-level enumeration of the Slovenian financial ADR bodies with scope, languages and contact details — an independent cross-check on the national IRPS register and a stable way to detect new/removed Slovenian ADR schemes.

source_name: IFLR1000 — Slovenia jurisdiction review and firm rankings
why_relevant: Directory review naming the SI financial/banking legal market's active firms and teams; the fastest snowball for building and refreshing the adviser actor map behind this cell.

source_name: INFOSEK conference (Nova Gorica) - security/compliance vendor and speaker programme
why_relevant: Slovenia's main information-security conference; DORA/NIS2/ZInfV-1 tracks attract the ICT suppliers that serve banks. Sponsor and speaker lists snowball into the regtech/security vendor ecosystem selling into SI financial entities.

source_name: Open Banking Tracker – Slovenia country and provider pages
why_relevant: Pointer directory enumerating SI ASPSPs and their developer-portal URLs; good for discovering smaller banks/savings banks' API programmes we would otherwise miss.

source_name: Računalniške novice - partner directory and event calendar (sl IT trade press)
why_relevant: Slovenian IT trade outlet that runs vendor profile pages (e.g. Halcom) and an events calendar. Good snowball surface for identifying SI IT suppliers with a finance practice and for catching vendor announcements that never reach English-language wires.

source_name: SBCA – Slovenian Blockchain Association
why_relevant: Second SI blockchain/crypto representative body; useful for triangulating industry positions on MiCA implementation and tax proposals and for discovering smaller SI crypto actors.
